company.name: Supy
company.shortDescription: Supy is a B2B software solution focused on streamlining transactions between restaurants and suppliers.
company.description: Supy is a software company founded in 2021 and headquartered in Dubai, focused on building digital solutions for the food and beverage (F&B) industry. It provides an all-in-one platform designed specifically for multi-location restaurant groups to manage back-of-house operations such as inventory tracking, procurement, supplier management, and business intelligence. The platform acts as an “operating system” for restaurants, enabling real-time visibility into stock levels, food costs, and purchasing activities. It automates workflows like purchase orders, invoice processing, and stock counting while integrating with POS, ERP, and accounting systems.
